Every exported item must have its page at the route derived from its path and kind; no item page may exist without its item; the tree must carry its <t4/>, and its <t5/> must be <t6/>; the library's index must carry its identity (<t7/>); the index's assets must be present; every internal link must resolve; and no page may name a machine path or a secret.
